ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a champion at my side
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: go into three fights with a loyal animal alongside

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} always said an animal that stands with you in a fight is worth ten that don't. I'll {GOAL}, for {NAME}.
When the raiders come, I want something with teeth beside me that's there because it wants to be.
[sparked] In the fight I saw someone's animal go for a raider's throat to save its person. I want that kind of loyalty.

warm.li: Not a weapon. A friend who'll stand with me when it's bad. I'll earn that.

blunt.li: I want an animal that bites the right people.

cheerful.li: Me and a great big animal, side by side, in every story they tell about the raids!

gloomy.li: Out there, alone, a person doesn't last. I'd like something at my side that won't run.

cold.li: A trained animal at one's side changes the arithmetic of a fight. I intend to have one.

plain.li: Three fights, side by side. It knows where I'll be before I move. I've stopped being afraid of the raids.
Three times now it's stood with me when it could have run. I save it the best scraps from every meal.

warm.li: The bravest friend I have sleeps at the foot of my bed.

blunt.li: Three fights. It held. So did I.

cheerful.li: We're a team now. The raiders should be afraid of us!

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a great beast tamed
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: tame one of the great beasts of this land

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} used to watch the big ones from the ridge and say "one day". I'll {GOAL} for {NAME}.
There's a kind of animal out there so big the ground shakes. I want one that knows my name.
Anyone can tame a goat. I want to stand next to something the size of a house and have it lean on me.

warm.li: Something that huge and that wild, choosing to trust me. Imagine it.

blunt.li: The biggest one out there. Tamed. By me.

cheerful.li: The biggest animal anyone's ever seen, and it'll eat out of my hand!

cold.li: The great beasts can be won over with enough patience. I have the patience.

plain.li: It lowers its great head when I come into the pen and waits for me to scratch behind its ear.
Children come from all over the colony to watch it eat from my hand.

warm.li: Something that size could crush me without noticing, and it's careful where it puts its feet when I'm near.

blunt.li: Tamed it. Biggest thing on the land, and it answers to me.

cheerful.li: I rode on its back. Well, I sat on it. It walked. That counts!

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a herd worth the name
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see the colony's herd grow to {COUNT} head

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} kept the herd going through the worst winters. I'll {GOAL}, and keep it going after.
A few animals in a pen isn't a herd. I want to see them come down off the hill in a line, too many to count at a glance.
[spring] The young ones are coming. If we keep them all, in two years we'll have a real herd.

warm.li: A big herd means milk for the children and wool for the winter. I'd like to give the colony that.

blunt.li: More animals. A proper herd, not a pen of strays.

cheerful.li: A whole herd, and I'll know every one of them by name!

cold.li: A herd of sufficient size feeds itself and the colony. I'll get us there.

plain.li: I stood at the gate this evening and counted them in. I lost count twice.
A herd worth the name, all of them healthy. My grandmother kept goats all her life and never had this many.

warm.li: Milk enough for everyone, and the pens full of noise. This is what I wanted.

cheerful.li: So many of them. I've run out of names and had to start on the colonists' middle names!

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: an animal that knows everything
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: teach one animal everything it can learn

plain.li: [inherited] {NAME} could make an animal do anything with a look. I'll {GOAL}, the way {NAME} would have.
Half-trained animals are worse than wild ones. I want one that knows every command there is.
[child] I'm going to teach my animal everything. Even the hard ones. Even the ones the grown-ups can't.

warm.li: Training isn't bossing it about. It's learning to talk to each other. I'd like to learn all of it.

cheerful.li: Fetch, guard, rescue, haul. It'll be able to do everything!

cold.li: A fully trained animal is a reliable tool. I'll produce one.

plain.li: It knows everything I can teach it. Now it's teaching me things: when it wants to go out, when something's wrong.
I gave the last command today and it did it before I'd finished saying it.

warm.li: We understand each other completely now. It's a strange, quiet feeling.

blunt.li: Fully trained. Best in the colony.

cheerful.li: It can do everything. Ask it something. Go on!
